items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: That’s right. Yeah, I’ve loved Fats from the beginning of my musical experience when I started at nine and he’ll be with me until I’m gone.

ctx.x: Well that’s Fats Waller. And I mentioned coming over today, Fats — Rochester was interviewing Fats one time and, “what is this thing, what kind of music you playing, Fats, this thing is swing or what?” Well Fats says, “You get that right tickin’ rhythm man and it’s on.”
Figure that out right? The right ticking rhythm.
